title: Dyadic shell decomposition of an integer multiplicity current around the dual skeleton (Simon 6.5.1, (8)–(10))
statement: Dyadic shell decomposition of an integer multiplicity current around the dual skeleton (Simon Ch. 6, proof of 5.1, displays (8)–(10) and the shells of E3). Assume, as hypotheses of the statement, (VO) the frozen type of Submission.dtc_vanish_off_support: for all P, n, U, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0; (MR) the frozen type of Submission.cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure: for U open and an IMRep R representing T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), M_W(T) = R.measure(W) for every open W; (REP) the frozen type of Submission.cmc_exists_massRepresentation: for U open and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U there are a Borel measure μ (μ(ℝ^P ∖ U) = 0, finite on compact subsets of U) and ξ (μ-a.e. strongly measurable, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α) with M_W(T) = μ(W) for open W, T(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ, and, if also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U, μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0; (IMC) the frozen type of Submission.cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub: (a) locality of approximate tangent spaces for Borel M ⊆ M' ⊆ U with Hⁿ(M' ∩ K) < ∞ (K ⊆ U compact); (b) the restriction (M ∩ E, θ, ξ) of an IMRep to a Borel E is an IMRep representing some current; (c) A − B is integer multiplicity for integer multiplicity A, B (U open); (d) |R.orient(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for Hⁿ-a.e. x in the carrier; (SL) the frozen type of Submission.cmc_slice_mass_bounds: for T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U) and ∂T represented by measures (μ, ξ), (μ', ξ') with |ξ|, |ξ'| ≤ 1 a.e. and f L-Lipschitz there are A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ(ω)dμ, B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ'(η)dμ' with ∂A_t(η) = B_t(η) when tsupport η misses {f = t}, M_W(∂A_t − B_t) ≤ L·liminf_{h↓0} h⁻¹μ(W ∩ {t − h < f < t}) and ∫⁻_{(a,b)} M_W(∂A_t − B_t)dt ≤ L·μ(W ∩ {a < f < b}). (These are exactly the frozen Lean types of the parent node's resolved dependencies, written as antecedents so that the child does not need those declarations; the parent instantiates them.) Let P, m ∈ ℕ (n := m + 1), T ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (domain univ) integer multiplicity with compact support, M(T) < ∞ and M(∂T) < ∞, let d : ℝ^P → ℝ be 1-Lipschitz and C ∈ ℝ≥0, and assume the density bounds M_{{d<r}}(T) ≤ C·r^{m+2}·M(T) and M_{{d<r}}(∂T) ≤ C·r^{m+2}·M(∂T) for every real r with 0 < r ≤ 1/4 (in [0, ∞], r^{m+2} through ENNReal.ofReal). Then there are radii r : ℕ → ℝ and currents W_j ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P), D_j, Z_j ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) (j ∈ ℕ) such that: (1/2)^{j+3} < r_j < (1/2)^{j+2}; Σ_j W_j(ω) = T(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (HasSum); ∂W_0 = D_0 − Z_0 and ∂W_{j+1} = D_{j+1} − (Z_{j+1} − Z_j); every W_j is integer multiplicity; spt W_j, spt D_j, spt Z_j are compact, M(W_j), M(∂W_j), M(D_j), M(Z_j) are finite and boundaryMassOn D_j ℝ^P, boundaryMassOn Z_j ℝ^P are finite; spt W_j ⊆ spt T ∩ {d ≥ r_j}, spt D_j ⊆ spt ∂T ∩ {d ≥ r_j}, spt Z_j ⊆ spt T ∩ {d = r_j}; M(W_0) ≤ M(T), M(W_{j+1}) ≤ C·(1/2)^{(j+2)(m+2)}·M(T), M(D_0) ≤ M(∂T), M(D_{j+1}) ≤ C·(1/2)^{(j+2)(m+2)}·M(∂T) and M(Z_j) ≤ 4C·(1/2)^{(j+2)(m+1)}·M(T). Conventions: ℝ^P = Euclid P (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)); for U ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^k(U) = TestFormOn U k (smooth k-forms on ℝ^P whose compact tsupport lies in U) and 𝒟_k(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U k (SimonGMT Chapter06), X(ω) the value of X on ω; X − Y is the contract subtraction, (X − Y)(ω) = X(ω) − Y(ω) (definitional); 0 is the zero current; ∂X = X.boundary, ∂X(η) = X(dη) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply, dη = exteriorDerivativeTestOn U k η, whose underlying form is exteriorDerivative η); currents are equal when their values agree (GeometricCurrentOn.ext). |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α is the Euclidean coefficient norm of a covector. M_G(X) = X.massOn G ∈ [0, ∞] is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal X(ω) over the ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x (such ω are admissible for M_G, massAdmissibleOn U k G); M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X); boundaryMassOn X G = M_G(∂X) if k ≥ 1 and 0 if k = 0. spt X = X.support (Simon 6.2.11) = U minus the zero region, the union of the open W with compact closure contained in U on which X vanishes (X(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω ⊆ W). IM = IsIntegerMultiplicity: X is represented by an IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) of the contract (R.carrier, R.mult, R.orient), i.e. X(ω) = R.action ω = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHⁿ, and R.measure = θ·Hⁿ⌞M (Hⁿ = μHE[n]).
